caption_fb:
Kowalski or Kowalska? Same family.

Polish surnames change with gender:
🔹 Kowalski (man) → Kowalska (woman)
🔹 In older records: -ówna for an unmarried daughter (Kowalczykówna), -owa for a wife (Kowalczykowa)

That's why a sister can look like a stranger in the parish book.

Behind every old surname is a real home and a family that used every form of it. Search them all, or you may miss half the family.
